_how_to_use: Copy to data/scanner.json and commit real calls only. History is append-only: close bad calls (status CLOSED), never delete them. Required per call: id, asset, calledAt (ISO), reason, status. Statuses: EARLY | HEATING UP | TRENDING | COOLING | CLOSED. Everything else is optional — omit what you don't know rather than guessing.

calls.reason: Reply velocity 4x in an hour, two large wallets accumulating
